candidates.source_name: European Commission — Kosovo Report (annual enlargement package country report, SWD series)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most authoritative annual statement of which EU financial-services and AML acquis Kosovo has transposed, what is missing, and what the Commission expects next. Chapter 4 (free movement of capital), Chapter 9 (financial services), Chapter 24 (AML/CFT) and Chapter 32 name specific EU instruments (PSD2/PSR, CRD/CRR, BRRD, AMLD/AMLR, DORA, MiCA) and give forward-looking 'in the coming year' obligations — the earliest reliable deadline signal for Kosovo banking/payments rulemaking.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse permitted under Commission reuse decision 2011/833/EU with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scheduled fetch of the enlargement package landing page each Oct/Nov; download country-report PDF; extract chapters 4, 9, 24, 28, 32; diff against prior year to isolate new commitments and deadlines.
queries_used: European Commission Kosovo Report 2025 financial services acquis alignment chapter 9

candidates.source_name: EEAS / EU Office in Kosovo — Kosovo Report translations (Albanian and Serbian)
candidates.why_relevant: The EU Office publishes sq and sr translations of the annual Kosovo Report. These give the exact local-language terminology ('pravne tekovine EU', 'përafrimi me acquis', 'shërbimet financiare') that Kosovo ministries and the CBK then reuse in their own drafts — essential for building search strings against national publishers.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of the sq/sr language variants of the report page; harvest terminology pairs into the glossary.
queries_used: Izveštaj Evropske komisije o Kosovu 2025 finansijske usluge usklađivanje sa pravnim tekovinama EU

candidates.source_name: European Commission — Enlargement package / EU Enlargement Policy Communication (strategy chapeau)
candidates.why_relevant: Sets the region-wide sequencing and any 'gradual integration' offers (e.g. SEPA access, capital-markets and payments integration steps) that determine when Kosovo must have PSD2/AMLR-equivalent rules in force. Cross-country framing often pre-announces conditionality before it appears in national law.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch alongside country report; keyword scan for payments/SEPA/financial services.
queries_used: European Commission Kosovo Report 2025 financial services acquis alignment chapter 9

candidates.source_name: Growth Plan for the Western Balkans — Reform and Growth Facility hub
candidates.why_relevant: Master pointer to Reform Agendas, payment requests, milestone-verification decisions and the €6bn facility rules. Because disbursement is conditioned on dated reform steps, this is the mechanism that converts EU financial-sector expectations into hard Kosovo deadlines.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of hub + linked document lists; watch for new payment-request/assessment documents naming Kosovo.
queries_used: Kosovo Reform Agenda Growth Plan Western Balkans financial sector payments milestones

candidates.source_name: Commission Staff Working Document SWD(2024) 243 — assessment of the Reform Agendas (incl. Kosovo)
candidates.why_relevant: Contains the Commission's step-by-step assessment of Kosovo's Reform Agenda, which is where individually dated reform steps (including public financial management, digitalisation and business-environment steps that touch payments/e-invoicing/AML) are enumerated.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off baseline extraction of the Kosovo annex; then track amendments to the Reform Agenda.
queries_used: Kosovo Reform Agenda 2024-2027 pdf enlargement.ec.europa.eu payments step

candidates.source_name: EEAS Delegation/EU Office in Kosovo — SAA Sub-committee on Economic and Financial Issues and Statistics press releases
candidates.why_relevant: The SAA sub-committee is the formal bilateral forum where the Commission records 'jointly agreed follow-up actions' for Kosovo in economic/financial policy — effectively a semi-annual to annual task list that precedes CBK and MoF rulemaking. Press releases are the only public window on an otherwise non-published process.
candidates.legal_status: public press material, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the Kosovo delegation press-release index filtered on 'Sub-committee'; capture sq/sr variants; extract follow-up action lists.
queries_used: EU Kosovo Stabilisation Association Sub-Committee economic financial issues statistics meeting

candidates.source_name: Council of the EU — Joint Conclusions of the Economic and Financial Dialogue with Western Balkans and Türkiye (ECOFIN)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual, dated, numbered policy guidance addressed individually to Kosovo, routinely covering financial-sector supervision, NPLs, banking legislation, AML capacity and payment-system modernisation. Non-implementation is flagged the following year, so the series gives both the deadline and the compliance track record.
candidates.legal_status: EU public document register
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual (May) retrieval from the Council public register by ECOFIN 1A document series; parse the Kosovo-specific policy-guidance block.
queries_used: Kosovo Economic Reform Programme joint conclusions economic financial dialogue EU Western Balkans ECOFIN 2026

candidates.source_name: DG ECFIN — Economic Reform Programmes of enlargement countries (Kosovo assessments)
candidates.why_relevant: The Commission's technical assessment of Kosovo's ERP includes a financial-sector chapter (banking soundness, supervisory gaps, capital-market and payments reform plans) and states which structural reform measures are behind schedule — a leading indicator of upcoming CBK regulation.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual (Apr/May) fetch of the institutional-paper landing page; extract the Kosovo country section.
queries_used: Kosovo Economic Reform Programme joint conclusions economic financial dialogue EU Western Balkans ECOFIN 2026

candidates.source_name: Kosovo Ministry of European Integration / Government — PKZMSA (National Programme for Implementation of the SAA)
candidates.why_relevant: The national mirror of EU conditionality: PKZMSA lists, per acquis chapter and per year, the exact Kosovo laws and sub-legal acts to be drafted to transpose EU financial-services and AML instruments, with responsible institution and target quarter. This is the operational deadline register for banking/payments rulemaking.
candidates.legal_status: government publication, public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch each programme edition; parse the annex tables for chapter 4/9/24/28 rows; diff editions to detect slipped or added measures.
queries_used: Kosovë Ministria e Integrimit Evropian PKZMSA plani kombëtar zbatimin MSA përafrimi legjislacionit
local_language_terms_used: Programi Kombëtar për Zbatimin e MSA-së

candidates.source_name: Office of the Prime Minister of Kosovo — PKIE / National Programme for European Integration 2024–2028
candidates.why_relevant: The successor instrument to PKZMSA (ninth successive programme), adopted by government Apr-2024 and Assembly Oct-2024. Contains the multi-annual legislative calendar for acquis transposition including financial services, capital movement and AML — the most granular forward calendar of Kosovo banking/payments legal change available anywhere.
candidates.legal_status: government publication, public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch; table extraction of legislative-measure rows keyed to acquis chapters; join to Kosovo Official Gazette to confirm adoption.
queries_used: Kosovë Ministria e Integrimit Evropian PKZMSA plani kombëtar zbatimin MSA përafrimi legjislacionit

candidates.source_name: Assembly of Kosovo — Committee on European Integration (legislative acquis-compatibility scrutiny)
candidates.why_relevant: Every draft law passing the Assembly is screened by this committee for acquis compatibility, producing a written opinion. For a banking or payment-services draft law this opinion states which EU instrument it transposes — an explicit, early, public link between a Kosovo bill and PSD2/AMLD/DORA.
candidates.legal_status: public parliamentary record
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll committee agenda/minutes pages weekly; cross-reference the draft-law register (projektligjet) for finance/payments bills; note sr mirror of the site.
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës Komisioni për Integrime Evropiane raportimi përafrimi acquis ligji shërbimet e pagesave

candidates.source_name: European Commission — Kosovo financial assistance under IPA (IPA III programming and action documents)
candidates.why_relevant: IPA action documents describe, with budgets and indicative timelines, the technical-assistance projects that actually write Kosovo's alignment with EU financial-services and AML rules. A new IPA action naming payment services, AML or supervisory convergence is a 2–4 year advance signal of regulatory change and of procurement opportunity.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual crawl of the Kosovo IPA page and its linked annual action programme PDFs; keyword filter on financial sector, payments, AML, digital.
queries_used: IPA III Kosovo annual action programme financial sector payments DORA MiCA AML alignment technical assistance

candidates.source_name: European Parliament — reports and resolutions on the Commission Reports on Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: Parliament's rapporteur reports restate and sometimes sharpen the financial-sector asks (AML effectiveness, banking supervision independence, SEPA accession). Useful as an independent read on which Commission demands have political traction, and the OEIL procedure file gives a dated trail.
candidates.legal_status: EU public document
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of the Kosovo AFET own-initiative report and the OEIL procedure file.
queries_used: European Commission Kosovo Report 2025 financial services acquis alignment chapter 9

candidates.source_name: EEAS — EU and Kosovo relations hub (sq/sr/en press and factsheets)
candidates.why_relevant: Central pointer to SAA bodies, joint economic policy guidance announcements, Growth Plan disbursements and sub-committee communiques for Kosovo, in all three run languages. Best single entry point for snowballing to dated bilateral events.
candidates.legal_status: EU institutional document, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the delegation press index across _en/_sq/_sr suffixes.
queries_used: "Agjenda e Reformave" Kosovë Ministria e Financave Plani i Rritjes BE hapat

candidates.source_name: Western Balkans Info Hub (westernbalkans-infohub.eu) — EU-funding and reform-agenda aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: EU-supported aggregator that republishes Growth Plan / Reform Agenda / IPA news for the region in a machine-friendlier feed than the Commission's own site, often with links to the underlying PDFs. Useful as a change-detection tripwire, not as a primary citation.
candidates.legal_status: third-party site, check terms before bulk scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news-index polling weekly with a Kosovo + finance keyword filter; always resolve to the primary EU document.
queries_used: Kosovo Reform Agenda 2024-2027 pdf enlargement.ec.europa.eu payments step

candidates.source_name: WeBalkans (webalkans.eu) — EU communication portal for the Western Balkans (multilingual incl. sq, sr)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-run outreach portal publishing Growth Plan / Reform Agenda explainers in Albanian and Serbian. Valuable mainly as a local-language terminology source and as a secondary alert channel for reform-milestone news.
candidates.legal_status: EU-funded site, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of sq/sr language sections for glossary building.
queries_used: Kosovo Reform Agenda Growth Plan Western Balkans financial sector payments milestones

candidates.source_name: Kallxo.com — Kosovo investigative outlet, EU-integration and Growth Plan coverage (sq)
candidates.why_relevant: Albanian-language reporting that puts figures and dates on Reform Agenda tranches (e.g. the €882.6m envelope) and often surfaces government documents before they are posted officially. Reveals-indirectly source for slipped milestones.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted news content — index headlines/links only, no bulk republication
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword monitoring on 'Agjenda e Reformave', 'Plani i Rritjes', 'BQK', 'ligji për pagesa'; store links and short summaries only.
queries_used: "Agjenda e Reformave" Kosovë Ministria e Financave Plani i Rritjes BE hapat

candidates.source_name: Radio Free Europe / Radio Evropa e Lirë & Slobodna Evropa — Kosovo EU-conditionality reporting (sq/sr)
candidates.why_relevant: Bilingual (sq at evropaelire.org, sr at slobodnaevropa.org) coverage of Commission decisions affecting Kosovo, including lifting/imposing of EU financial measures — events that directly change the tempo of the EU-driven rule pipeline.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted news content — link and summarise only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword alerts across both language sites on Komisioni Evropian + Kosovë + masat/financiare, and Evropska komisija + Kosovo + mere.
queries_used: "Agjenda e Reformave" Kosovë ...
Izveštaj Evropske komisije o Kosovu 2025 finansijske usluge

candidates.source_name: ecoi.net — mirrored archive of EU enlargement country reports
candidates.why_relevant: Stable third-party archive of Commission country reports with persistent IDs. Useful fallback when enlargement.ec.europa.eu rotates its opaque document-download URLs, which it does between publication cycles.
candidates.legal_status: archive of public EU documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a resolution fallback only; prefer the Commission original for citation.
queries_used: European Commission Kosovo Report 2025 financial services acquis alignment chapter 9

candidates.source_name: Kosovo Ministry of Justice — Department for European Integration and Policy Coordination
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry-level EU-integration departments are the units that produce the acquis-compatibility statements attached to draft laws (including AML/CFT and asset-confiscation files that bind banks). Illustrates the ministry-level pattern to replicate at the Ministry of Finance.
candidates.legal_status: government publication, public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; primarily used to locate the equivalent unit and contact points at the Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers.
queries_used: Kosovë Ministria e Integrimit Evropian PKZMSA plani kombëtar zbatimin MSA përafrimi legjislacionit

negative_findings.description: No public, per-meeting agenda, minutes or 'jointly agreed follow-up actions' document for the EU–Kosovo SAA Sub-committee on Economic and Financial Issues and Statistics could be located; only EEAS press releases summarising each meeting were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced press releases for the 5th, 6th and 7th sub-committee meetings but no underlying documents, no document register, and no fixed meeting calendar.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The follow-up action lists are the crispest EU-driven deadline artefact for Kosovo financial-sector rules; without them the pipeline must be reconstructed from press releases plus the next annual country report, losing several months of lead time.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific EU document was found that explicitly names DORA, MiCA or PSR as instruments Kosovo is scheduled to transpose.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted searches combining Kosovo with DORA / MiCA / PSD2 / PSR / AMLR against IPA and enlargement domains returned only generic IPA III financing announcements and no instrument-level commitment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is a real possibility that Kosovo's EU-driven pipeline is currently anchored on older instruments (PSD2/AMLD, banking recovery and resolution) rather than the 2023–2025 acquis wave. Treating DORA/MiCA transposition as scheduled would be an unsupported assumption; this must be confirmed by reading the country-report chapters directly rather than inferred.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language (sr) Kosovo-government source for the EU-driven rule pipeline was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language searching returned EU/EEAS and Serbia-focused material plus the CBK Serbian annual report, but no sr-language version of PKIE/PKZMSA or an sr Assembly EU-integration page was confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kosovo is officially bilingual; an sr-language gap risks missing documents published only on the Serbian-language mirrors of rks-gov.net sites, and weakens coverage of the Serb-majority banking constituency.

negative_findings.description: Commission enlargement document URLs are opaque, UUID-based download links with a filename query parameter rather than stable permalinks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two different UUID URLs were observed for the 2025 Kosovo Report; the 2024 report uses a third. No stable canonical URL pattern was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any stored URL for a Commission country report is likely to break between cycles, so collection must resolve documents from the enlargement package landing page each year rather than by stored link, with ecoi.net as a fallback resolver.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo Reform Agenda itself (the operative annex listing dated reform steps and their payment linkage) was not retrieved as a standalone document; only the Commission's approval news and the aggregate SWD were found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch SWD(2024) 243 in full and the Reform Agenda annex for Kosovo from the Growth Plan hub; extract the step table and flag any step touching payments, digital public finance, e-invoicing, AML or financial supervision.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed mapping exists yet from Kosovo's transposition programmes (PKIE/PKZMSA) to named EU financial-services instruments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse PKIE 2024-2028 and PKZMSA 2022-2026 annexes for chapters 4, 9, 24, 28 and 32 and build an instrument-to-national-law crosswalk; this converts the cell from narrative to a dated deadline register.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found for public consultation on EU-alignment draft laws (Kosovo's electronic public consultation platform was not covered in this cell).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Hand off to the national-publisher cell: locate Kosovo's e-consultation platform (konsultimet.rks-gov.net) and the Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) and join them to the PKIE calendar to catch drafts at consultation stage.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of the EU-driven pipeline rests almost entirely on EEAS translations and regional media rather than on Kosovo institutional sr-language pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the sr mirrors of kuvendikosoves.org, kryeministri.rks-gov.net and integrimievropian.rks-gov.net directly for sr versions of the integration programmes.

coverage_gaps.description: The Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers' own EU-integration unit and its sectoral working group for Chapter 9 / Chapter 4 were not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Identify the National Council / sectoral working group structure for SAA implementation and its Chapter 4/9/24 working groups, which are the bodies drafting the financial-services alignment measures.

brief: Kosovo's EU-driven banking and payments rule pipeline is documented almost entirely outside national publishers, in four interlocking document families: the Commission's annual Kosovo Report (acquis chapters 4, 9, 24, 28, 32), the Growth Plan / Reform and Growth Facility Reform Agenda with its payment-linked reform steps, the annual ECOFIN Joint Conclusions and DG ECFIN's Economic Reform Programme assessment, and the EU–Kosovo SAA Sub-committee on Economic and Financial Issues. These are mirrored nationally by the transposition programmes PKZMSA 2022-2026 and PKIE 2024-2028 plus the Assembly's Committee on European Integration acquis-compatibility opinions, which together are the only place where an EU instrument is tied to a named Kosovo law and a target quarter. Access is generally open and legally reusable, but Commission document URLs are unstable UUIDs, sub-committee follow-up action lists are not published, and no Kosovo-specific document was found in this pass that names DORA, MiCA or the PSR — so the instrument-level pipeline must be confirmed by direct reading of the country-report and PKIE annexes rather than assumed. Serbian-language institutional coverage is the weakest dimension and should be probed on the rks-gov.net sr mirrors.
